retirements.replacement: Explicit video is retained by the canonical Capture runtime.
retirements.guard: The compatibility hook may remain hidden; it may never become a visible Settings owner.

retirements.replacement: Photo / Scan / Video canonical Capture plus app-owned Scan sampling preference.
retirements.guard: 3秒 / 5秒 mean Scan sampling duration only; they are not video/capture-mode choices.
Delegation is allowed; visible ownership or independent persistence is forbidden.

retirements.replacement: 8.18 sealed 30fps canvas compositor with source-first media contract
retirements.guard: Historical low-frame-rate or forced-720p recording paths may not return.

retirements.historicalSurface: Version-like filenames and release notes treated as current authority
retirements.guard: Historical filenames never define current product ownership.

retirements.historicalSurface: Archived/history content imported back into current runtime or release authority
retirements.replacement: Current source or explicit compatibility adapters
retirements.guard: History/provenance may not become executable authority without an explicit reviewed promotion.

retirements.historicalSurface: Seven separate automatic workflows for 8.14 through 8.18
retirements.guard: The seven retired workflow files may not return; source/data compatibility remains separately governed.

retirements.historicalSurface: Four automatic AXIS 8.13 Runtime Core / Shadow Runtime / Live Route / Settings workflow families
retirements.guard: The four retired 8.13 workflow files may not return. Pure Runtime, Shadow, base-SHA parity, Live Route and Settings remain required through Runtime Foundation.

The nine retired compatibility workflow files may not return. Legacy storage readability, reminder/Home behavior, Group Plan, Personal Equipment, Learning and 8.12.4/8.12.5 behavior remain required through Deep Compatibility.

retirements.replacement: explicit Object metricSchema -> executable recording surface, with proven legacy fallback only when no explicit schema exists
retirements.guard: An explicit Object schema such as pace-only or duration+intensity must never fall back to weight/reps/sets merely because a coarse legacy kind is strength/cardio.

retirements.historicalSurface: strength/cardio decides whether Active exists or whether set controls render
retirements.replacement: executionMode plus immutable Flow whole-item provenance decides admission; immutable Encounter schema still governs classic v61 metadata authority
retirements.guard: sets/rounds/timed/hold are ongoing; ordinary single/complete remain one-shot. Only an Encounter already proven as a Flow whole-item may reuse existing v82/v87 Active. Set controls remain sets-only and no Flow-specific Active owner may appear.

retirements.historicalSurface: Production workflows infer current capabilities from manually enumerated release strings
retirements.replacement: exact local release manifest + exact source SHA + immutable asset/topology parity; historical release gates are explicitly scope-limited
retirements.guard: Current Production gates must not guess capabilities from a stale version allowlist. Historical gates may retain historical version scope but must skip later releases explicitly.

retirements.historicalSurface: Flow progresses or completes by individual set-level actions
retirements.replacement: one complete Object is the Flow completion unit and uses the existing Active lifecycle where ongoing interaction is required
retirements.guard: Flow must not expose an independent active-set completion writer or advance the Flow because one set completed.

retirements.historicalSurface: 开始此项 opens Quick Record configuration before the Flow item starts
retirements.replacement: current Flow item starts directly through the existing v82/v87 Active lifecycle; Quick Record remains explicit temporary/detour recording
retirements.guard: The current Flow item may not regain an intermediate Quick configuration route. Detour Quick Record must never consume or advance the current Flow item.

retirements.historicalSurface: saved-item UI exposes raw strength/cardio/mobility/functional enum strings
retirements.replacement: source-owned localized saved-item metadata in the established Quick Record owner
retirements.guard: Internal enum IDs may remain persisted for compatibility but must not appear as user-facing saved-item metadata.

physicalDeletionRequires: replacement owner or proof that no replacement is needed
deletionPolicy.rule: Retirement does not authorize deletion unless equivalent current responsibility is proven. CI orchestration may be deleted after exact-candidate equivalent coverage and external check-name constraints are verified.
